login.title: Sign in to People OS
login.subtitle: Internal system of FREITTY · NETQOR · YBIS
login.devHint: Pick a seeded test user. Disabled in production.

errors.invalid: Wrong email or password. After 5 failed attempts sign-in is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Sign-in is locked for 15 minutes — try later or contact HR.
errors.default: Could not sign in. Please try again.

login.panelTitle: People, requests and payments in one place
login.panelText: Onboarding, time off, shifts, access and equipment for the whole holding team.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask HR or an administrator for a new one.

employee.name: Name
employee.basicNotice: You see the basic colleague directory data.
employee.rateHint: Rates are never edited: a new rate closes the previous one the day before.
employee.deleteConfirm: Delete this profile? The record will be marked as deleted.

org.title: Org structure
org.name: Name
org.confirmDeleteCompany: Delete company “{name}”? Its history (requests, audit log) is kept.
org.confirmDeleteDepartment: Delete department “{name}”? Its history (requests, audit log) is kept.

cannotDelete.has_people: Cannot delete: {n} people still work here. Move them to another department first (or finish their offboarding).
cannotDelete.has_departments: Cannot delete: the company still has {n} departments. Delete or move them first.
cannotDelete.has_subdepartments: Cannot delete: the department has sub-departments. Delete them or give them another parent first.

org.subtitle: Companies, their departments and people's locations.
org.dangerHint: History (requests, audit log) is kept. Only an empty record can be removed.
org.timezoneHint: Shifts and due dates (SLA) depend on the time zone. IANA format: Europe/Kyiv, America/New_York.
org.headsHint: A head approves the department's requests and sees its people (sub-departments included).
org.companySummary: {departments, plural, one {# department} other {# departments}} · {people, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
org.noCompaniesHint: Start with “New company” at the top.
org.noDepartmentsHint: Add the first department — people can then be assigned to it.
org.locationsHint: City and time zone of people

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.locked: Superadmin always has every permission — this role cannot be edited.
roles.intro: The superadmin configures what each role can do. The "own departments" scope means departments the person heads, including sub-departments, plus their own profile.

import.title: CSV import
import.order: Order: companies & departments first, then employees, then rates, balances, access and equipment. Locations and systems are created in the UI.
import.hasErrors: There are errors — fix the file and upload it again. Nothing was saved.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.redacted: hidden — no access to this data

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this action.
errors.conflict: Conflict: the record already exists or the action is not allowed.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended, please sign in again.
errors.internal_error: Server error. Please try again later.

requests.title: Requests
requests.noTypes: There are no request types you can start
requests.subject: Employee
requests.cancelConfirm: Cancel this request? Open steps will be closed.

step.rejectHint: A comment is required to reject
step.checklistHint: The step closes once every item is ticked
step.childAuto: The child request was created automatically

rule.subject_manager: The employee's direct manager (or department head)

templates.title: Request templates
templates.label: Label
templates.groupsHint: Steps in a stage run in parallel; the next stage starts when every step of the previous one is closed.
templates.noErrors: The template is ready to publish
templates.readOnly: Read only: you cannot edit this template

systems.title: Systems & access templates
systems.name: Name
systems.bundleHint: During onboarding the template pre-fills the child access request when the position matches.
systems.subtitle: Services people get access to, and access sets per position.
systems.systemsHint: The system owner grants and revokes access
systems.ownerHint: The owner gets the “grant access” and “revoke access” steps in requests.
systems.activeHint: An inactive system cannot be chosen in new requests.
systems.noSystemsHint: Add the services people use: Google Workspace, CRM, Slack…
systems.noBundlesHint: A template is a set of systems for a position: “Operator” → CRM, telephony.
systems.noBundlesNeedSystems: Add at least one system first.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subscribeHint: Add this link in Google Calendar → "Other calendars" → "From URL". The link is personal — do not share it.
calendar.rotate: Issue a new one (the old link stops working)

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.importHint: CSV columns: date, end_date, title_uk, title_en, recurrence (yearly/none), non_working (yes/no).
settings.workWeekHint: Mon–Fri by default. A location overrides its company.

accruals.upfront: all at the start of the period

expiries.end_of_period: at the end of the period

settings.policiesHint: Each policy counts one type. The default one applies to every employee unless a company, department or person has another one. Contractors have no PTO.
settings.assignHint: The most specific assignment wins: person → department (and sub-departments) → company → the type's default policy.

balance.title: Time off
balance.notEligible: PTO is not part of the engagement terms
balance.noTypes: No absence types with a balance are configured

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.importHint: Columns: work_email, start, end (local time "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm"), shift_type, department, company. Times are in the employee's location time zone.
shifts.timezoneHint: Times are entered in the employee's location time zone; a shift over midnight belongs to its start date.

payments.title: Payments
payments.lockConfirm: Close the period? Its shifts will be locked and it can no longer be recalculated.
payments.unpaidDays: more than {days} days after the period end
payments.coefficientHint: Multiplier for shifts on weekends and non-working holidays of the employee's calendar. 1.0 = no premium.

warningCodes.no_rate_for_shift: no rate on the shift date
warningCodes.monthly_rate_with_shifts: monthly rate — shifts are not paid separately

errorPage.notFoundText: It may have been removed, or you do not have access to it.
errorPage.errorText: Please try again. If it keeps happening, contact the administrator.

telegram.linked: Done! People OS notifications will arrive here. Send /stop to turn them off.
telegram.unlinked: People OS notifications are off for this chat.
telegram.badCode: The code is invalid or expired. Generate a new one in your People OS profile.
telegram.help: This is the People OS bot. To connect notifications: your People OS profile → "Notifications" → "Connect Telegram".

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.notConfigured: The bot is not configured by the administrator yet (no TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN). In-app notifications work.
notifications.codeHint: Open the bot with the link or send it: /start {code} (the code is valid for {minutes} min).

shell.searchPlaceholder: Search people by name or email

absenceInsight.title: For approval
absenceInsight.last: Since the last absence of this type: {n} days ({from} — {to})
absenceInsight.lastNone: No earlier absences of this type
absenceInsight.hint: Warnings never block the request — the approvers decide.

warnings.min_days: Below the minimum for this type ({n} days)
warnings.max_days: Above the maximum for this type ({n} days)
warnings.available_from: By length of service this type is available from {date}
warnings.no_policy: No policy for this type — no balance is counted
warnings.not_eligible: Contractor: no PTO, the absence is only recorded
warnings.no_hire_date: No start date — no balance is counted

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: The new password works right away; other sessions end.
password.mustChange: You signed in with a one-time password. Choose your own to continue.
password.rules: At least {n} characters; avoid parts of your email and obvious passwords.

errors.same_as_current: The new password must differ from the current one.
errors.contains_email: The password must not contain your email.

access.title: Access
access.subtitle: Who can sign in to People OS and with which role.
access.shownOnce: Copy it now — this password cannot be shown again. Share it through a secure channel; at the first sign-in the system asks the person to set their own password.
access.newHint: Creates the account and the employee card. The password is generated after saving.
access.roleHint: The role sets the rights. Operator, manager etc. are positions — they get the role “User”.
access.sectionCardHint: PTO is counted from the start date.
access.confirmReset: Issue a new password for {name}? The old password stops working and every session ends.
access.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate access for {name}? They cannot sign in until access is activated again.
access.ownAccountHint: Your own password — key icon at the top
access.onlyYouTitle: So far only you have access
access.onlyYouHint: Click “Issue access” at the top: email, name, role → “Generate password”. Hand the password to the person.
access.step1Hint: Email, name, role and department — the employee card is created with the account.
access.step2Hint: The one-time password is shown only once.
access.step3Hint: At the first sign-in they set their own password. Forgot it — “Reset password”.

dashboard5.emptyUpcoming: No events in the next two weeks
dashboard5.emptyDocs: Nothing expires in the next 30 days

requests2.listSubtitle: Requests you can see: yours, about you and your team's.
requests2.emptyHint: Create a request — time off, access, equipment or anything else.
requests2.yourStepHint: The request is waiting for you.
requests2.insightSince: Since the last absence of this type
requests2.newSubtitle: Choose a request type and fill in the form — it then follows its approval route.

kindHint.hiring: Find and hire a new person
kindHint.onboarding: A new person starts: access, equipment, documents
kindHint.offboarding: Someone leaves: revoke access, return equipment
kindHint.absence: Vacation, sick leave, day off, remote day

requests2.tasksEmptyHint: When a request reaches your step, it appears here and in notifications.
requests2.notifSubtitle: What happens with the requests you take part in.
requests2.notifEmptyHint: New tasks, overdue steps and request results arrive here.

people2.listSubtitle: Employees of the holding's companies: cards, contacts, statuses.
people2.noResultsHint: Change the search or the filters.
people2.createSubtitle: Employee card. Access to the system is issued separately in Access.
people2.sectionStatusHint: PTO and probation are counted from the hire date.
people2.notificationsHint: Where to send notifications about tasks and requests
people2.calendarSubtitle: Holidays, absences, birthdays and anniversaries in one place.

ops2.shiftsSubtitle: Shift schedule for a period: planning, confirmation by the head, CSV import.
ops2.shiftsEmptyHint: Change the period or department above, or add a shift.
ops2.shiftAdded: Shifts added: {n}. You can add the next one.
ops2.costSplitHint: By default the company and department from the profile. The shift is paid in the period of the company chosen here.
ops2.paymentsSubtitle: Calculate a period's payments, contractor documents, approval and payout.
ops2.paymentsOwnSubtitle: Your payments and those of your departments.
ops2.periodsHint: Pick a period to calculate and close it
ops2.noPeriods: No periods yet — create the first with “New period”.
ops2.periodLocked: The period is closed — changes and recalculation are not available.
ops2.pickPeriod: Pick a period on the left to calculate payments.
ops2.paymentsEmptyHint: Payments appear after a period is calculated.
ops2.assetsSubtitle: Laptops, phones and licenses: who has what and what it costs per month.
ops2.assetsEmptyHint: Add a laptop, phone or license — then it can be assigned to a person.
ops2.assetCostHint: Monthly costs of licenses add up to “Licenses per month”. Leave it empty for equipment without a subscription.
ops2.templatesSubtitle: Request builder: form fields and approval stages.
ops2.templatesEmptyHint: Create a template, add form fields and stages — once published, requests can be filed.
ops2.codeHint: Latin letters, digits and “_”, no spaces. Cannot be changed later.
ops2.newTemplateHint: The builder opens after creating: form fields, stages and steps.
ops2.metaHint: Name and who can file the request
ops2.fieldsHint: What the person fills in when filing the request
ops2.noStages: No stages yet — add the first one.

admin2.rolesSubtitle: What each role can do and who has which role.
admin2.newRoleHint: Permissions are copied from the chosen role — you can change them afterwards.
admin2.codeHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and _ — for example team_lead.
admin2.importSubtitle: Move data from spreadsheets into People OS — checked before anything is saved.
admin2.csvOnly: CSV format, the first row holds the column names
admin2.previewHint: Start with “Preview”: the system shows what would be created or changed and saves nothing.
admin2.nothingToImport: Everything is already in the system — nothing to import.
admin2.readyToCommit: The check passed. Click “Confirm import” to save.
admin2.auditSubtitle: Who changed what in the system, and when.

admin2.typesHint: What a person can choose in an absence request
